about: Prism Deck Game Link demo: a fictional online 3v3 Rocket League match as the Stats API messages a player's game sends ({ Event, Data }), in order, with their receive times (atMs). Copied from prism-deck/test/fixtures/gamelink/rl (the documented message shapes, invented values). Our team is Blue: only Blue's cars carry boost and speed — the game withholds the other team's. False and zero values are left out, as the game does. Names are invented, platform ids out of range, the MatchGuid all zeros. Replay each payload through normalizeRl(payload, prev, { nowMs: T0 + atMs }) (src/apps/sources/gamelink-rl.js).
